kebab_example: aliyun iacservice create-resource-export-task --client-token a65451293e64979ba7a4b573950217fe --description this_is_description --export-to-module source=Registry sourcePath=oss::https://iac-daily.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/iacservice/vpc.zip statePath=oss::https://iac-daily.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com/default/terraform.tfstate --include-rules '[{"values":["cn-chengdu"],"key":"RegionId"}]' --name abc --ram-role role-name --terraform-provider-version 1.247.0 --terraform-version 1.5.7 --trigger-strategy Auto --variables '[{"properties":["vswitch_name"],"resourceType":"ALIYUN::VPC::VSwitch"}]' --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateResourceExportTask

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. Format: [0-9a-zA-Z-]{1,64}. We recommend that you use a UUID
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The description of the resource export task
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en:
The module type in which the exported template is saved. Valid values:

OSS: OSS.
Registry: Terraform Registry
fields.help_zh:
导出后的模板保存的Module类型。可选值：

OSS  ：OSS
Registry: Terraform Registry
fields.name: source

fields.help_en: The path for saving the template content. Set this parameter when source is set to OSS
fields.help_zh: 保存模板内容的路径值，source = OSS时设置
fields.name: source_path

fields.help_en: The path for saving the template state file. Set this parameter when source is set to OSS
fields.help_zh: 保存模板State文件的路径值，source = OSS时设置
fields.name: state_path

parameters.help_en: Saves the exported template as a module. If this parameter is not specified, the template is automatically saved in the Registry
parameters.help_zh:
将导出后的模板保存为Module。
如果未设置，那么将自动保存在Registry中
parameters.name: export_to_module

fields.help_en:
The name of the inclusion rule used when exporting resources. Valid values:

ResourceType: required. The resource type. Call ListResourceTypes to view the list of supported resources. Example: ALIYUN::VPC::VPC.
RegionId: required. The region to which the resource belongs. Only one region is supported. Example: cn-chengdu.
\<ResourceType>:Id: the resource ID. Example: ALIYUN::VPC::VPC:Id.
ResourceGroupId: the resource group ID. Example: rg-1234.
ZoneId: the zone to which the resource belongs. Only one zone is supported. Example: cn-hangzhou-h.

By default, multiple filter conditions are evaluated using the AND operator. A resource is considered a match only when all filter conditions are met
fields.help_zh:
资源导出时的包含规则名称。可选值如下：

ResourceType：必填，资源类型，使用 ListResourceTypes 查看支持的资源列表，例如：ALIYUN::VPC::VPC
RegionId：必填，资源所属Region，当前只支持一个Region，例如：cn-chengdu
\<ResourceType>:Id：资源ID,例如：ALIYUN::VPC::VPC:Id
ResourceGroupId：资源组ID，例如：rg-1234
ZoneId：资源所属Zone，目前只支持一个Zone，例如：cn-hangzhou-h

多个过滤条件之间默认是与的关系，即必须符合所有过滤条件，才视为匹配过滤条件
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The list of values for the inclusion rule used when exporting resources
fields.help_zh: 一组资源导出时的包含规则的值列表
fields.name: values

parameters.help_en: The list of inclusion rules used when exporting resources
parameters.help_zh: 导出资源时使用的包含规则列表
parameters.name: include_rules

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource export task. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length.
The name can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.). The name cannot start or end with a hyphen, underscore, or period.
The name must be unique among resource export tasks within the current account
parameters.help_zh:
资源导出任务名称，需满足下述要求：

长度为 3~63 个字符。
允许大小写字母、数字、中文、短横线（-）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.），且不能以短横线、下划线、半角句号开头或结尾。
名称在当前账号的资源导出任务资源下唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The RAM role (1 to 128 characters). The system assumes this role to execute the template when a new job is triggered. This parameter is required when the job trigger method is not manual
parameters.help_zh:
RAM角色，（1-128）
触发新作业时由系统扮演角色来执行模版
作业触发方式非手动触发时必填
parameters.name: ram_role

parameters.help_en: The Terraform provider version. Call ListTerraformProviderVersions to view the list of supported versions. Default value: the latest version
parameters.help_zh: terraformProvider版本，使用 ListTerraformProviderVersions 查看支持的版本列表，默认为最新版本
parameters.name: terraform_provider_version

parameters.help_en: The Terraform version. Call ListAvailableTerraformVersions to view the list of supported versions. Default value: 1.5.7
parameters.help_zh: Terraform版本，使用 ListAvailableTerraformVersions 查看支持的版本列表，默认为1.5.7
parameters.name: terraform_version

parameters.help_en:
The trigger strategy. Valid values:
Auto: triggered when rules are modified or the trigger strategy is changed to Auto.
Manual: manually triggered.

Default value: Manual
parameters.help_zh:
触发策略，有效值：
Auto： 当修改规则或触发策略被改为Auto触发
Manual：手动触发

默认值为：Manual
parameters.name: trigger_strategy

fields.help_en: The list of properties of the Terraform resource that corresponds to the resource type
fields.help_zh: 资源类型对应的Terraform资源的属性列表
fields.name: properties

fields.help_en: The resource type. Call ListResourceTypes to view the list of supported resources
fields.help_zh: 资源类型，使用 ListResourceTypes 查看支持的资源列表
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The list of variables. Exported resource parameters are set as variables
parameters.help_zh: 变量列表，将资源导出后的参数设置为变量
parameters.name: variables
